verdict.rationale: Sardine documents business entity screening through KYB verification in the dashboard and the async /businesses API, plus rules on business entities. It also offers UBO Screening, which combines KYB with KYC/AML on owners, and supports ownership and control rules such as OFAC's 50 Percent Rule, which together cover linked ownership risk context. Missing for 10: detail on how an analyst views or navigates ownership and association links (e.g., an ownership graph or entity relationship view), coverage of non-ownership associations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
